releases.notes:
## Fixed

- **Clickable choices work again.** Server buttons that open a dialog or send a custom action, like Hypixel's NPC options (`[Yeah] [Never heard of him]`), did nothing with Yap Chat. Clicks now go through the vanilla chat handler, so every click type works as it does without the mod, including command confirmation and shift-click insertion.
- **Buttons inside repeated messages.** Clicking a button in a message merged into `x2` now presses the button instead of expanding the repeats. The button from the newest copy is used.
- **Hover text in chat.** Hovering over messages shows server hover text, item tooltips and entity info again.
- **Chat visibility.** The vanilla "Chat: Hidden" and "Commands Only" options now work with Yap Chat.

releases.notes:
KKS Chat is now **Yap Chat**. Your old `config/kks-chat.json` is picked up automatically.

Download on [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/yap-chat) or below. Pick the jar for your Minecraft version: 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, 26.2, 26.3, or one of the older versions: 1.16.5, 1.18.2, 1.19.2, 1.20.1, 1.21.1, 1.21.4, 1.21.11.

## New

- **Settings screen.** It replaces the vanilla Chat Settings screen and also opens from Mod Menu. Every change applies right away, and the right column explains the option under the mouse and shows a live preview. Tabs:
  - **General:** styling, anti-spam, show time, visible messages, history size.
  - **Appearance:** chat position, background opacity, appear/hide animations with a looping preview.
  - **Messages:** icon and background color for every message type.
  - **Bubbles:** everything about chat bubbles, with a preview on your own character.
  - **Minecraft:** all vanilla chat options.
  - **Advanced:** menu accent color, rules, server patterns, config folder.
- **Chat bubbles** above players who write in public chat.
  - Styles: dark, white pixel, tooltip, name tag.
  - Settings: size, time, range, opacity, width.
  - Resource packs can restyle every bubble style. See the README.
- **Accent color** for the settings menu, if red is not your color.

## Fixed

- Opening the settings from Mod Menu on the title screen crashed the game on 26.3.

## Message handling (since 1.3.0)

- Message types are recognised from what the game reports (chat type, translation keys) instead of guessing from text. Works in every language, plus built-in patterns for EssentialsX/CMI and Hypixel-style servers.
- Whispers show both heads with an arrow.

## Older Minecraft versions

1.3.1 is also available for 1.16.5, 1.18.2, 1.19.2, 1.20.1, 1.21.1, 1.21.4 and 1.21.11 (Fabric, needs Fabric API). All features are there. A few small differences:

- Item icons don't fade with the message; they disappear at the end of the fade.
- The cursor doesn't change over clickable chat text before 1.21.11 (hover tooltips work everywhere).
- 1.18.2 and 1.16.5: player chat and whispers are recognised from translation keys and formats, and the Minecraft tab has no option descriptions.
- 1.16.5 needs Java 16 or newer (the launcher uses Java 8 for 1.16.5 by default, so change it in the installation settings).
